_comment_source: Example values. Defaults to the repository's ./skills tree; adjust target roots to match your installed agent environments.
_comment_optional_targets: Opt-in only. sync_skills.py (--include-agents-root) and sync-skills.ps1 (-IncludeAgentsRoot) never touch these roots unless explicitly requested, and a missing root fails instead of being created. Delete this list (or leave it empty) if you do not use an agents skill root.
_comment_manifest: skills lists every skill this manifest owns; sync_skills.py and sync-skills.ps1 mirror strictly inside each listed skill directory and never create, delete, or modify anything else in target roots. Copy to manifest.json or pass via --manifest / -ManifestPath.
